items.docs: Create a new protected asset for one or more brands. Protected assets are URLs, handles, or identifiers that your organization wants to monitor for unauthorized use. The asset must be unique per organization, and the brands must belong to your organization.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the protected asset to delete

items.docs: Delete a protected asset. This removes the asset from your organization's protected assets list, meaning it will no longer suppress alerts for matching content.

params.name: platform_name
params.description: Filter by platform (e.g., linkedin, facebook, twitter, domains, instagram)

params.name: brand_ids
params.description: Filter by multiple brand IDs (comma-separated, max 100)

params.name: brand_names
params.description: Filter by multiple brand names (comma-separated, case-insensitive, max 100)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip for pagination

items.docs: List protected assets for the authenticated organization. Filter by platform and/or brand IDs/brand names, with pagination support. Protected assets are URLs, handles, or identifiers that your organization wants to monitor for unauthorized use across various platforms.
